title: Use Claude + GPT To Make High CTR Ad Creative
description:
marketwithmark.com

Most businesses don’t actually have an ad problem… they have a messaging problem.

In this workflow, I use Claude to scan landing pages, identify key messaging angles, hooks, and creative direction… then use GPT to generate the actual ad creatives from those insights.

This is one of the fastest ways I’ve found to create better-performing Meta ad creatives without staring at a blank screen for hours.

#AI #MetaAds #FacebookAds #ClaudeAI #ChatGPT #AdCreative #DigitalMarketing #MarketingStrategy #AIMarketing #BusinessGrowth
